original_ai_output.title_zh: 南苏丹执政党SPLM禁止现役武装部队成员参加党内提名
original_ai_output.summary_zh: 南苏丹执政党苏丹人民解放运动（SPLM）宣布，禁止现役武装部队及其他有组织部队成员参加该党内部提名程序。SPLM秘书长阿科尔·保罗·科尔迪特表示，现役军人须退役并正式脱离现役后方可参与党内活动。该提名程序在朱巴于10月9日截止，随后该党将派团前往各州分发提名表格。

key_facts.fact: 南苏丹执政党SPLM禁止现役武装部队成员参加党内提名
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: South Sudan’s ruling Sudan People’s Liberation Movement (SPLM) has barred active members of the armed forces and other organised forces from participating in its internal nomination process ahead of the country’s planned December elections.

key_facts.fact: SPLM秘书长科尔迪特称现役军人须退役后方可参与党内活动
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: He said members of the forces would only be eligible to participate after they had been decommissioned, officially released from service and are no longer active members of the SSPDF or other organised forces.

key_facts.fact: 朱巴的提名程序定于10月9日星期五截止
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: The nomination process in Juba is due to close on Friday, Oct. 9, Kordit said.

uncertainties: 该事件目前仅有一个来源（Radio Tamazuj）报道，尚缺乏交叉验证
